name: Gutleben-Hofschank
kurzbeschreibung:
Welcome to **Gutleben-Hofschank** in **Tirol**, where tradition meets hearty Alpine hospitality. Nestled in the picturesque heart of the region, this historic inn invites you to savor authentic Tyrolean flavors in a cozy, rustic setting.

Indulge in a steaming bowl of **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized shreds of pancake—served with fresh fruit compote and a dusting of powdered sugar. Pair it with a frothy glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** (Tyrolean apple strudel) or a rich **Käsekrainer**, a local specialty of grilled sausage with melted cheese.

After your meal, warm up by the crackling fireplace with a **Schnaps** or a smooth **Grüner Veltliner** from the nearby vineyards. The **Zirbenholz**-panelled rooms offer a tranquil retreat, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring **Innsbruck**, the **Karwendel** mountains, or the charming villages of the **Inntal**.

Whether you're here for the **Tiroler Volksmusik** (Tyrolean folk music) evenings or the crisp mountain air, **Gutleben-Hofschank** promises an unforgettable taste of **Tirol**’s timeless charm. **Willkommen!**
